method: Every account in the HQ196 successor was re-read against the repaired broker and decoder blobs. For each, two DISTINCT facts were recorded and never merged: whether the quantity is measurable/enforceable, and whether a numeric pre-launch budget is actually known.

the_two_facts_are_not_the_same.fact_1: measurable_enforceable -- the candidate can count it and cap it BEFORE the operation.
the_two_facts_are_not_the_same.fact_2: numeric_budget_known -- an exact/floor/zero/max PRE-LAUNCH value exists, from frozen authority or from a source-independent count proven at the governed scope.
the_two_facts_are_not_the_same.why_the_distinction_matters: The repaired broker is a large advance on fact 1 and NO advance at all on fact 2. Reporting an enforceable-but-unbounded account as a bound budget would fabricate authority.

accounts.pre_operation_enforcement: budget.check(account, existence_checks=1) BEFORE the stat; counter bumped after
accounts.counts_what: one application-side existence/access check (path.is_file()), not an open

accounts.pre_operation_enforcement: budget.check(..., hash_passes=1, hash_bytes=size) BEFORE the digest loop
accounts.counts_what: one whole-file SHA-256 pass performed in Python over the governed open; no second physical open

accounts.counts_what: application-owned physical open() of the source path; the compiled reader receives a position-zero view and never a path string

accounts.pre_operation_enforcement: budget.check(..., header_prefix_reads=1, header_prefix_bytes=prefix_size) before the read
accounts.counts_what: bounded raw header-prefix reads performed in Python over the governed open

accounts.missing_owner: NO COUNTER EXISTS. 'decoder_invocations' has zero occurrences in the repaired broker. SourceAccessAccount counts reader_invocations (compiled-reader calls) but has no decoder-entry counter, and the receipt's measurement_basis does not list one. The O1-C07 mandatory decoder-call account therefore has NO owner at all.

accounts.counts_what: compiled-reader invocations with no column restriction

accounts.code_owner: rawlsing_next/pre553_source_access_broker.py reader_bytes / hash_bytes / header_prefix_bytes counters; limiter armed per reader invocation
